title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4CITY - AccessibilityConcept
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/AccessibilityConcept. SKOS concept used to list the accessibility modes (e.g. metro, wheelchair access, hearing loop, sign-language interpretation) that can be linked to an Event via hasAccessibility. Subclass of skos:Concept (http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#Concept). SAREF4CITY defines no datatype property of its own for this class; its identity and meaning are carried entirely by its `id` (a URI identifying the specific accessibility mode, e.g. urn:ngsi-ld:AccessibilityConcept:metro), consistent with how the normative ETSI TS 103 410-4 worked example uses a bare individual (ex:metro) without any additional literal attribute.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'AccessibilityConcept'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
